description: Inline functions and macros for jemalloc's tcache management, including allocation, deallocation, and cache state handling.

methods.name: tcache_enabled_get
methods.description: Inline function to get whether tcache is enabled for a thread-specific data (tsd).

methods.name: tcache_enabled_set
methods.description: Inline function to enable or disable tcache for a given tsd.

methods.name: tcache_event
methods.description: Handles tcache garbage collection events, triggering hard cleanup if needed.

methods.name: tcache_alloc_small
methods.description: Allocates small objects from the tcache, possibly falling back to hard allocation.

methods.name: tcache_alloc_large
methods.description: Allocates large objects from the tcache, possibly falling back to arena malloc.

methods.name: tcache_dalloc_small
methods.description: Deallocates small objects into the tcache.

methods.name: tcache_dalloc_large
methods.description: Deallocates large objects into the tcache.

methods.name: tcaches_get
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a tcache for a given thread-specific data index.
